a store to an unmapped page: SIGSEGV, code 1, si_addr the address
a store to a PROT_NONE page: SIGSEGV, code 1, si_addr the address
a store to a read-only page: SIGSEGV, code 1, si_addr the address
a load from a PROT_NONE page: SIGSEGV, code 1, si_addr the address
a store at 0x10: SIGSEGV, code 1, si_addr the address
a store at 0x1010: SIGSEGV, code 1, si_addr the address
write barrier: 2 faults for 3 stores, the stores made
stack overflow: caught on the alternate stack (SIGSEGV)
